notes.title: Steam Achievements-now live and functional!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I've just finished setting up several Steam Achievements-15 of them in total-for SHELL_BREAK. Below is the list of Achievements that are live and available:

1. I've just read a manual
2. Rollin' up the sleeves
3. I'm just getting warmed up...
4. Tear down the firewall!
5. The doctor's in
6. Good for health
7. Bad for education
8. Grenade out!
9. Mad bomber
10. Duke of Nuk-er-shire
11. I, myself
12. Blessed union
13. You, the beloved
14. Forevermore
15. Alone in the universe


Also, here's a link to the original source code, written by cyanic in RPG Maker forum, that was used to implement the Steam Achievements for this game:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/cyanics-steam-achievements-integration.50640/

Should there be any issues or trouble regarding the achievements, please let me know ASAP via a discussion thread, or contact me straight away.

I hope you'd enjoy SHELL_BREAK as always, and see you very soon!


Best,
STDIO_934.

notes.title: Small fixes have been made on map tiles and item properties.
notes.content:
Dear fans,


Some minor fixes have just been made on the game, regarding issues with some of the in-game map tiles and properties of certain items(such as HP recovery rate, etc.). Details on the recent changes are listed below:


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34005238/74e47e93679383f9d22eec26726c4172a3b25862.png[/img]

Some issues regarding a set of map tiles posted above, in which you could pass through the each side of these gates freely even though they appeared to be 'closed', have been fixed; you can no longer walk through them unless they are opened.


2. Recovery rates of HP_STIM and FP_STIM have been increased.


3. Buffs have been made on SMOKE_BOMBs, making them more effective versus enemy units.


4. Encounter rates of certain Terminal Maps are lowered; enemy troops will appear less frequently on these maps from now on.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Should there be any questions or issues on these recent changes of SHELL_BREAK, please let me know through comments either on this patch note or discussion pages of Steam Community. :)


With my best regards,
ghilplip934.
